verdict.rationale: Loops' own API docs say it offers integrations, naming Zapier and Make, plus incoming webhooks that trigger workflows. That is first-party integration capability, but the evidence shows no direct connectors to the systems the story names; reaching Stripe, Shopify, Segment or a product database would mean routing through Zapier/Make or writing custom API code. Missing for 10: documented native Stripe/Shopify integrations, a Segment/CDP connector, a product-database sync, an integrations catalog showing maintenance status, independent corroboration.
